root_cause.text: Use-after-free of struct nf_queue_entry due to concurrent access to a global rhashtable where entries can be freed via kfree while another CPU performs a hash lookup or list traversal without proper synchronization.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "struct nf_queue_entry is freed via kfree, but parallel cpu can still encounter such an nf_queue_entry when walking the list." The patch removes the global hash table (`nfqnl_packet_map`) and makes it per-instance, along with converting the instance cleanup to use RCU work (`INIT_RCU_WORK`) to ensure entries are no longer in use before freeing.
